summary.principle: The composite fires ONLY the signal(s) whose transfer condition is VALIDATED for the input's biology, at calibrated/capped confidence, and ABSTAINS where no validated signal transfers. 'Any disease' = honest DECISION coverage (a real answer where a signal transfers; an explicit abstention where none does), NOT a universal model.
summary.verdict: CAPSTONE: the validated composite decided end-to-end across 6 representative inputs spanning every reachable disease class -- 5 produced a signal-backed routed output (bacterium->FBA full-grade; eukaryote/fungus->FBA; virus->structural class-ID; human-cancer->functional-dependency; host-dependent parasite w/ GEM->FBA CAPPED+uncertainty-flagged), and 1 correctly ABSTAINED (novel zero-screen parasite: no validated signal transfers, TRANSFER1). 1 fired with an explicit uncertainty flag. Every fired signal is backed by a committed, reproduced-x2, prereg'd validation (see per-case validated_by). This is the fullest vision working as ONE honest system: it neither over-claims a universal model nor under-claims 'bacteria only' -- it applies what is validated per biology and refuses where it is not. SCOPE: composition of already-validated in-silico target-PRIORITIZATION signals; hypotheses with provenance, not validated drugs; not wet-lab; not clinical.
